description: This PHP source file defines the LDAPSyncService class within the OrangeHRM project. The class manages synchronization between LDAP server users and the system's internal user database, including fetching LDAP entries, creating or updating system users, and handling LDAP settings and connections.

classes.name: LDAPSyncService
classes.description: Main service class responsible for synchronizing LDAP users with the internal system, managing LDAP connections, fetching LDAP entries, creating and updating system users, and handling LDAP configuration settings.

methods.name: getLDAPDao
methods.description: Returns the LDAPDao instance used for LDAP data access operations.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Initializes and returns the LDAPService instance, establishing LDAP connection with proper credentials.

methods.name: getLDAPSetting
methods.description: Retrieves LDAP configuration settings, throws exception if not configured.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersWhoHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Returns employee numbers associated with multiple user accounts, caching result.

methods.name: fetchAllLDAPUsers
methods.description: Fetches all LDAP users and groups them into a collection, handling duplicates and failed entries.

methods.name: getHashOfLDAPUser
methods.description: Computes a MD5 hash of an LDAPUser object for identity comparison.

methods.name: createSystemUsers
methods.description: Creates or updates system users based on LDAP user data, handling existing users and merging strategies.

methods.name: trySaveEmployee
methods.description: Attempts to save employee data; dispatches event upon success, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: warnMultiUserEmployee
methods.description: Logs a warning if an employee has multiple users.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists employee data after validating email and employee ID uniqueness.

methods.name: filterLDAPAuthProvider
methods.description: Filters authentication providers to find LDAP-specific provider.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Main synchronization method that fetches LDAP users and updates the local system, with transaction management.

methods.name: fetchEntryCollections
methods.description: Retrieves LDAP entries collections based on configured lookup settings, caches results.

methods.name: fetchEntryCollection
methods.description: Fetches LDAP entries for a specific lookup setting, caching results to optimize performance.

methods.name: prepareLDAPUserFromEntry
methods.description: Transforms a LDAP entry into an LDAPUser object, extracting attributes based on data mapping, and logs errors if issues occur.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a specific attribute from an LDAP entry.

methods.name: getSearchAttributes
methods.description: Generates a list of LDAP search attributes based on data mapping and lookup setting.

methods.name: deleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServer
methods.description: Deletes local system users that no longer exist on the LDAP server.
